name: Val Demings
subject: I'm on the cusp of taking the lead

body:
I can only take the lead if I have the resources to counter the GOP's attacks
Hi, friend – sorry for reaching out again, but with hours left before my midnight deadline, **I'm still falling $12,562 short of what I need to take the lead in this close race.**

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: I just finished my Georgia Thrives address. Derek, I’m counting on you to help get it done.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I just walked off the stage after sharing my
vision for Georgia’s economic future. As governor, I will bring more
capital to small businesses, expand the pool of skilled labor and champion
inclusive policies to build a diverse and thriving economy. We can do this
and more to put money in the pockets of working Georgians, all without
raising taxes.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220809_B3_JustLefttheStage_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1387%2E1862389%2EGZecwm ]But first, I need your help to win this election. I’m relying on
grassroots
supporters to build a Georgia where everyone can thrive.
Can I count on your support to make my vision a reality?

Derek, I am a
daughter of Georgia. I am a daughter of the South — raised in Mississippi,
I came of age in Georgia. Faith, education and service were our family
values — undergirded by the understanding that all of it meant an
obligation to work — to put your head down, shoulder to the wheel, and
push as hard as you could to make life better for yourself and those you
love.

For my parents and millions of families, the deal was supposed to be
simple. Put in a fair day’s work and receive a fair day’s wage. But the
deal didn’t always turn out as it should. My mom worked as a college
librarian and my father was a shipyard worker — and sometimes that wasn’t
enough to keep the lights on and the water running in our house.

Most Georgia families are doing everything right. They are upholding their
responsibilities — and yet they are still just one illness or bad turn
from a financial precipice that never seems to disappear. And the truth is
Brian Kemp’s extreme, dangerous agenda not only increases violence and
risks lives, his reckless policies endanger Georgia’s economy.

Because right now in Georgia, under Brian Kemp, rent is sky high,
inflation has destabilized our economy, and the price of groceries is
increasingly out of reach. Georgians are struggling to feed their
families. But right now, we have a governor who is more focused on
political stunts than providing stability for Georgia families.

As governor, I will wake up every morning with your family, your hopes,
your challenges in mind. I won’t brag about starving Georgia’s citizens
from the very funding — their money — that can serve their greatest and
most pressing needs.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220809_B3_JustLefttheStage_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1387%2E1862389%2EGZecwm ]But I need your help to get there. Derek,
can you please chip in now to seize this
moment, undo all the harm Brian Kemp has done to our economy and build One
Georgia, where everyone has the opportunity to thrive?

My pledge to not raise taxes and do our best for Georgia is not just to
win an election. It is about how I was raised.

When I was 10 or so, I got to go with my granddad to the neighborhood gas
station. With five siblings and nine cousins, alone time with him was a
rare treat. I chattered the whole way there about books and school and
summer plans. When we arrived, I proudly went inside to pay to fill up the
tank and to buy some candy. On our way home, I told Granddaddy a secret —
the man at the store had given me too much change.

My grandfather whipped his car around and drove back to the station in
silence. As he pulled in front of the store, he turned to me with a look
of disappointment. He told me that what I had didn’t belong to me.
Instead, by keeping the extra money, I had put that attendant in jeopardy.

His stern face softened, and he explained, what felt like a win to me
meant that someone else would be paying the bill. Technically, yes, I
could have it, but at what cost?

My job was to go back inside and tell the truth. To return the money so
that man could take care of his responsibilities. I dutifully got out of
the car and gave the gentleman the extra $5. His look of relief and
surprise were their own rewards — and I got a piece of bubblegum for my
troubles.

What my grandfather taught me that day was profound: what feels like extra
may be just enough to do what’s right.

Losing that $5 might have cost that man his job.

Derek, I live
this lesson every day. We can do what’s right for Georgia — by investing
in our economy, saving health care, building infrastructure, and taking
care of our small businesses, our workers, and our bottom line. We can
turn our state around and give back what has been taken from too many
Georgians.

In November, we will set our course for the next decade, for the next
generation. We will choose an economy that serves us all or builds off the
backs of many to support the few. Our next governor will deploy the
largest surplus in a generation — but will it go to our future or to his
friends?

Stacey Abrams

body:
There’s a lot on the line in this race. | | | Peter, it’s official: **WFP champion Mandela Barnes has declared victory in the Wisconsin Senate primary. Now, he’ll face Republican Ron Johnson in just three months.** Ron Johnson is one of the most vulnerable Senators up for reelection. Even before today, Republicans launched attack ads against Mandela because they’re **that** worried he will flip this battleground seat. Earlier tonight, I called Senator Balint to concede the race and congratulate her on her victory. Although tonight didn’t go the way we hoped, I want to extend my deepest appreciation and most heartfelt thanks to our entire team, volunteers, supporters, and voters from every corner of this state. **No matter what each day brought, we kept our focus on what matters most: doing the hard work and giving Vermonters a choice.** This team accomplished a lot. We notched key endorsements, including major unions and beloved Vermont leaders like Howard Dean and Madeleine Kunin. We consistently met our fundraising goals. Our field team held thousands of voter conversations, keeping this election competitive in the face of a tsunami of outside spending. We left it all on the field. I couldn’t be prouder of this team. On a personal note, if someone had told me years ago that running for Congress was something that a farm kid from Newbury could do, I wouldn't have believed it. I will always be proud of the choice we gave Vermonters, and grateful for the chance to be part of a conversation about the future of this state I love so very, very much. It remains the honor of my life to serve as Vermont's Lieutenant Governor. I look forward to continuing to serve the people of this state I love. My sincere thanks again for believing in me, this team, and the next generation. Yours in gratitude, _Molly_

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

body:
**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60969286:J06JZLVUN:m:1:3331421248:1E96EAAD12E513CAEF784CF599EE1D5F:r)**

Peter,
The FBI's raid of Mar-a-Lago is yet another escalation in the weaponization of federal agencies against the Regime's political opponents, while people like Hunter Biden get treated with kid gloves. Why didn't the FBI ever raid Hillary Clinton's house after she laundered classified information through a private server and then deleted 30,000 emails that were under subpoena?

**The federal Regime is targeting those it dislikes for disfavored treatment**. They are demanding we get in line or face the consequences.

Now, the Regime is getting another 87,000 IRS agents to wield against its adversaries. With this addition, the agency is now larger than the Pentagon, State Department, FBI, and Border Patrol combined, and BILLIONS of dollars are now being directed to fund these new hires. Democrats are not simply expanding an agency. They are growing their army of Biden Regime soldiers standing ready to execute any order by the D.C. Swamp.

The fact that the Left is turning taxpayer-funded government agencies into extensions of the Democrat Machine to do their political bidding right before our eyes should be alarming to every American. **These are not actions indicative of leaders in a free republic._This mirrors a Banana Republic._**

As your Governor, I have always been clear that the power belongs to the People -- _**_not politicians_.**_ This blatant overreach by the federal government is an attack on our democracy and the American people.

It is past time that elected representatives in Washington, D.C. stand up against this abuse of power by using the constitutional power of Congress to hold these agencies accountable. For too long these agencies have been on autopilot with no accountability. Let's make sure they stand up for our rights. No excuses! - _**[Stand with me>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60969286:J06JZLVUN:m:1:3331421248:1E96EAAD12E513CAEF784CF599EE1D5F:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=d0025c081abf2c0c1a0129edd35ee3585ab5764993ef33c944348d145a64d3cdf1fe2dd5a15e89a76fa2a12131287ac420fe5b6547a2f839")**_

Ron DeSantis

body:
A $300 billion reduction in the federal budget deficit over the next ten years sounds like a good thing, right?
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zovefi8qoq6i6cl0es7aq8nd89bb85r1fpsnedag_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ei3bd9ieir38cth6kpjactmekpradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcsjgmprj8cdmc6or5dhnm9hr8o36c1ibacdjm3ie2tjkcsrb6d9jm2q36chmm1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9o6cc5gmdi3fcjmcoob1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm0p32clhm6p324no)
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl53pdkpp6ehbb468nbfveub51sibec7crfg8m7g_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor3chh2bs)
Friend,

A $300 billion reduction in the federal budget deficit over the next ten years sounds like a good thing, right?

Unfortunately, the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) is unlikely to do as its name implies.**In fact, the government 's own budget scorekeeping agency just reported that the deficit reduction won't even begin until 2027 -- until then, all the spending hikes in the legislation actually make the deficit worse! **

But that hasn't stopped Democrats from trying to rush this bill through Congress.

Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). Since our founding in 1969, our mission is to achieve practical policy wins toi improve the lives of taxpayers, using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states. We've won many victories in reducing taxes, stopping wasteful spending programs, and protecting your rights as a taxpayer.

Friend, NTU is voicing our concerns over this act. Will you help us lobby on behalf of taxpayers?

[_**Please support NTU 's efforts by donating $25, $50, $100, or any amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl1c5q6vam2o0hvil87979oni2nefas0a4tndi18_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor3chh2bs)

Over 10 years, the IRA is projected to reduce the deficit by $300 billion, but the details show this is highly unlikely.

Based on the timing of the new spending and taxes in the bill, it's almost certain that _the IRA would spend more than it saves_ in the early years.

Any front-loaded deficits will increase interest payments on the national debt.

**Each $100 million increase in spending in 2023 adds another $27 million to debt interest costs over the decade.**

The legislation would also give the Internal Revenue Service more funds for enforcement -- claiming to target high earners who are _" tax cheats." _

After 34 years at NTU, working on five separate IRS reform bills, I can tell you that this enforcement ploy doesn't meet rosy revenue projections - but it does often lead to due process violations for Americans up and down the income ladder.

[_**NTU is working on voicing taxpayer concerns against this bill. Your urgent donation will benefit our lobbying efforts. Click here to show your support >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zivvrcuinkod5l7cupbolcpumitqqutk7iqtjam0_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor3chh2bs)

If Congress was serious about fighting inflation, they could take action like clawing back the massive spending hikes enacted in 2021 now taking effect, and increasing energy supplies to stabilize prices.

Then there's making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent. NTU led a coalition to pass this landmark tax reform bill in 2017. Since then, the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act has generated economic growth. With a recession potentially on the horizon, Americans need to be able to count on moderate tax bills going forward.

Instead, Congress is attempting to pass a bill filled with recycled bad policy ideas that will unlikely have any significant impact on inflation.

That's why I need your help, Friend. Please help NTU lobby against short-sighted policies like the Inflation Reduction Act by clicking below.

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpietmtpptlp46oaob734fnvvgbjlu18s6n4kuso_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor3chh2bs)

Then there's making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent. NTU led a coalition to pass this landmark tax reform bill in 2017. Since then, the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act has generated economic growth. With a recession potentially on the horizon, Americans need to be able to count on moderate tax bills going forward. Instead, Congress is attempting to pass a bill filled with recycled bad policy ideas that will unlikely have any significant impact on inflation. That's why I need your help, Friend. Please help NTU lobby against short-sighted policies like the Inflation Reduction Act by clicking below. This legislation could reach President Biden's desk in just a few days, unless we fight back now. Please do your best! subject: Will you help me fire Pelosi’s #1 Republican ally?
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvd8946suev2jui8n0vcu8f4d6lgu7hg14msotm0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfccjnc2rb0s736qrb8s3ke1ir7dhksmom3cb6csq6eclnmiqrbcjmeiobacbm61jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coojecr0supbaphh6ipm8dtgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhm0p32clhm8pb24no)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkt5i9n2tb9s95mtm3nupch7mfpdhqko4l3rbop8_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zok7hghc3m2ph47lk68u4q49112q90vd4nidq518_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuocntu33uujv1god6ua5i8foh63kpimn9prgom8_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh4qpq2qtq6ks9lgel3hjeuk91m2mjvtluk8qfe8_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5e9rvvcs2493cd8t76g91fbvbing08gn2leuq28_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqeeprsof228qttnv912tql50t0sh7n29tdepc7g_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4ufs07oa51rqpek25q3at3m5k554qfahg8fc760_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs) [DONATE](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0pkot8f7o7189789dc5bsecl6m7rhr1g0tf9l2g_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor4clh2bs)

subject: Please, my husband (an Afghanistan vet) needs your help

body:
Next week is going to be hard for veterans.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zobsbjrhn9lolof0h6e14ta6aisuatsh1pe9rus0_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq9dhkumqb7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sjjc1rm6cb0e8qj1dhlelie6ophcli74objc9rj0shmcdom1cj46aq3cdhlcmoefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup70phgm2pm8dtielj3co5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| |
---
| | Friend,
---
| The one-year anniversary of the day Kabul, Afghanistan fell to terrorists in Joe Biden’s botched withdrawal is less than a week away.

And for my husband – Republican Congressman and U.S. Army veteran Brian Mast – this is a day that I know will be hard for him.

You see, when the entire country watched American citizens left behind, saw troops needlessly killed and recognized that women would be subjugated under the Taliban, I remember seeing something in my husband’s eyes...

...It was him questioning whether all of his sacrifice fighting the Taliban in Afghanistan was even worth it.

For those that don’t know, Brian was nearly killed after an explosive device planted by the Taliban went off directly beneath him while he was serving in the Kandahar region of Afghanistan. The blast took both of his legs and part of his hand, but by the grace of God, his life was spared.
---
| [PLEASE HELP ME SHOW BRIAN HIS SACRIFICE WAS WORTH IT!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8jjug8vrdq7oju10de44kvkfbrvjkn21mfkm7lo_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs "PLEASE HELP ME SHOW BRIAN HIS SACRIFICE WAS WORTH IT!")
---
| I remember the moment the soldiers knocked on my front door to tell me the news. I didn’t know if he was dead or alive, but since then, he has gone on to be a dedicated public servant and an incredible father to our four beautiful children:
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhg9ivq6cnqvj2n9i06vg2joga7hpcdflishlkt0_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs)
---
| It’s been a blessing to watch Brian’s road to recovery – he’s the most determined and selfless man I know. When he sets out to do something, there’s nothing he can’t accomplish.

But still, I know this tragic ending in Afghanistan – a place where he nearly gave his life for the Stars and Stripes – was a major setback for him and for every other veteran who sacrificed in this mission.

That’s why my husband has been focused on accountability ever since. Over the course of this past year, Brian has been using his platform in Congress to do everything he can to hold Joe Biden accountable for his failures.

**There’s just one problem: this has severely cut into my husband’s time he can spend fundraising for his re-election in Congress. **Running a campaign costs millions of dollars, and that’s especially the case this year since Brian is running for a new House seat after redistricting.

**Now, voters are already casting ballots and Election Day is in less than two weeks.** That’s why I hope you’ll join me to show Brian that we believe in his mission to get accountability for Afghanistan!

[**Please, will you help me with a fundraising drive to pool the $15,000 that’s still needed in order for Brian’s campaign to stay on track before Election Day?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvhb8rhk0j88s2eadvk6jjd6lsract2j0pculj50_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs)
---
| [DONATE HERE TO SUPPORT BRIAN’S MISSION](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z07jnocerseiee894kh07a9i8vtc86mq17gljb10_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs "DONATE HERE TO SUPPORT BRIAN’S MISSION")
---
| Thank you for everything you can give. I know it will mean a lot to my husband seeing us have his back ahead of this challenging anniversary!

God bless you,
Brianna Mast

P.S. - Your gift of [_$50_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zks6p256lrrk5038elr3i4lqefm14hsrujrtcjfg_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs) , [_$35_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrp1t8p5hdor9s1p864ijg8mf9out33esephqvjg_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs) , [_$10_ ,](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1fj4v48l5pbliaekje8mb7ad2c5g8om2n2i78gg_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs) or [_anything you can afford_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zirbrf1g4i1ma9688dom54t3ol0op9is7hl09djo_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs)[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjflakv0o922a9fp7vhu2a9q16tnrckkg6idlfkg_rp22sh2s8i66or0chh6aor5c3h2bs)also helps ensure that Brian and his Republican colleagues take back the House in November – something that will give my husband much more leverage to hold Joe Biden accountable for Afghanistan. Thank you once again from the bottom of my heart.
---

clean_body: Next week is going to be hard for veterans. |MCPREVIEWTEXT| | | | | | Friend, | The one-year anniversary of the day Kabul, Afghanistan fell to terrorists in Joe Biden’s botched withdrawal is less than a week away. And for my husband – Republican Congressman and U.S. Army veteran Brian Mast – this is a day that I know will be hard for him. You see, when the entire country watched American citizens left behind, saw troops needlessly killed and recognized that women would be subjugated under the Taliban, I remember seeing something in my husband’s eyes... ...It was him questioning whether all of his sacrifice fighting the Taliban in Afghanistan was even worth it. For those that don’t know, Brian was nearly killed after an explosive device planted by the Taliban went off directly beneath him while he was serving in the Kandahar region of Afghanistan. The blast took both of his legs and part of his hand, but by the grace of God, his life was spared. | "PLEASE HELP ME SHOW BRIAN HIS SACRIFICE WAS WORTH IT!" | I remember the moment the soldiers knocked on my front door to tell me the news. When he sets out to do something, there’s nothing he can’t accomplish. But still, I know this tragic ending in Afghanistan – a place where he nearly gave his life for the Stars and Stripes – was a major setback for him and for every other veteran who sacrificed in this mission. name: Team Andy
subject: Sign if you agree: Members of Congress shouldn’t trade stocks
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
When members of Congress are sworn into office, they take an oath to " faithfully discharge the duties of the office ." Members of Congress are entrusted by the people to serve their community's needs, not their own self-interests.

Sadly, trust in government continues to erode. We need to rebuild that trust and ensure that every member of Congress is serving their constituents, first and foremost.

That's why Andy is pushing for Congress to ban members from trading stocks – it's a top priority for him and for this movement.

Will you add your name to call on Congress to ban congressional stock trading and restore the public's trust in government? [https://action.andykim.com/a/petition-ban-stock-trading-e?contactdata=nVeK0mXf%2FEvyECwIsT0%2FGxRBYKJxZq%2FyEs%2FTC9j5rGMVNxRqv%2FmRHsF%2BI0bUqhKJhPRyBUNcptH%2FfIkd8tJTi6LAHRrqQ%2Bq16p3s8BBiUKTxGDnnFdi33zCz2HVfMJwS0JmDzrnxHIxVEkic4gUhYA%3D%3D]

It's not hard to see why it's a huge conflict of interest for members of Congress to be trading stocks.
Members of Congress are put in positions of power where they decide where taxpayer money goes or whether Medicare should negotiate drug prices (spoiler alert: of course, it should, but we'll talk about that in a different email). But how can we ensure that members of Congress are making decisions based on the needs of their constituents if they stand to profit – sometimes millions of dollars – from certain bills passing or failing?

We need to clean the slate and ensure every member of Congress is serving their constituents, not their own stock portfolio.

Sign the petition and tell Congress: Ban congressional stock trading and restore the public's trust. [https://action.andykim.com/a/petition-ban-stock-trading-e?contactdata=nVeK0mXf%2FEvyECwIsT0%2FGxRBYKJxZq%2FyEs%2FTC9j5rGMVNxRqv%2FmRHsF%2BI0bUqhKJhPRyBUNcptH%2FfIkd8tJTi6LAHRrqQ%2Bq16p3s8BBiUKTxGDnnFdi33zCz2HVfMJwS0JmDzrnxHIxVEkic4gUhYA%3D%3D]

Andy's Republican opponent has millions of dollars in stock holdings and has so far refused to sell his stocks in pharmaceutical companies. This is wrong. The American people shouldn't have to wonder whether their representative is doing the bidding of Big Pharma or actually serving the people they represent.

Members of Congress must honor their oaths and serve the people, not their stock portfolios. We can rebuild and restore public trust in government by getting stock trading out of Congress.

Team Andy

clean_body: When members of Congress are sworn into office, they take an oath to " faithfully discharge the duties of the office ." Members of Congress are entrusted by the people to serve their community's needs, not their own self-interests. Sadly, trust in government continues to erode. We need to rebuild that trust and ensure that every member of Congress is serving their constituents, first and foremost. That's why Andy is pushing for Congress to ban members from trading stocks – it's a top priority for him and for this movement. Will you add your name to call on Congress to ban congressional stock trading and restore the public's trust in government? [] It's not hard to see why it's a huge conflict of interest for members of Congress to be trading stocks. Members of Congress are put in positions of power where they decide where taxpayer money goes or whether Medicare should negotiate drug prices (spoiler alert: of course, it should, but we'll talk about that in a different email). But how can we ensure that members of Congress are making decisions based on the needs of their constituents if they stand to profit – sometimes millions of dollars – from certain bills passing or failing? We need to clean the slate and ensure every member of Congress is serving their constituents, not their own stock portfolio. Sign the petition and tell Congress: Ban congressional stock trading and restore the public's trust. [] Andy's Republican opponent has millions of dollars in stock holdings and has so far refused to sell his stocks in pharmaceutical companies. This is wrong. The American people shouldn't have to wonder whether their representative is doing the bidding of Big Pharma or actually serving the people they represent. Members of Congress must honor their oaths and serve the people, not their stock portfolios. We can rebuild and restore public trust in government by getting stock trading out of Congress. Dear friend,

The voters of Southern Minnesota have spoken, and I want to congratulate Brad Finstad on winning the Special Election last night.

Though I had hoped to celebrate different news with you all, there is plenty for which to be hopeful. We won big in our primary, we outperformed pundits and polls, and we have momentum in a new, advantageous district.

I want to thank the thousands of supporters all across the district who put their trust in our campaign. This was always going to be a double-header, two-stage election, with November likely to have three times the turnout of the August election. Our campaign continues to believe that this district is ready for a common-sense problem solver. We look forward to bringing that message to every corner of Southern Minnesota in the months to come.

Onward together,
Jeff Ettinger |

If you want to overcome eyesight problems without surgery or coughing up money to an eye doctor...

name: Catherine Parker
subject: Our To Do List
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Approved by Catherine For Congress
body:
Our To Do List
As most of you know, I love checklists. Every morning I start my day with a list and it guides me through the day. I add new items and love crossing things off as I’ve accomplished them. In my life as a mom, small business owner, and legislator, I've learned to be a master multi-tasker, and I never give up on a list. I’ll bring that same dedication to getting things done to Congress. Here’s my upcoming to do list:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/79102/images/todo%20list.png]
✅If you want a woman in Congress to get the job done, put making a contribution today on your To Do List! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherine-for-congress-1]
I hear from constituents every day and they are telling me that gun safety, a woman's right to choose, climate change , our infrastructure , and supporting our allies in Israel and NATO are the most important issues that they need action on. And the must-do list goes on: universal health care , affordable housing , social justice and human rights for people of color, LGBTQ+, and immigrants, supporting working families, seniors, and students, returning the full SALT deduction to our district, and last but not least, ensuring our voting rights .

To get a list like this done, we’ll need two things. First, we need a Congressperson who does more than say nice things, but who actually has a record of listening to the community and making meaningful change. Second, we need YOUR help in the next two weeks as a volunteer [https://www.mobilize.us/catherineforcongress/] and donor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherineforcongress] .
Won’t you strike an item off YOUR To Do list for today by donating now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherine-for-congress-1]

name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I'm the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin
body:
Derek,
The polls are closed in Wisconsin, and I am honored to be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate. This wouldn't have been possible without people like you. Thank you.
Let me be very blunt:
This is going to be a very tough race, and defeating Ron Johnson won't be easy.
He has been courting his special-interest donors and corporate PAC contributors since he announced his re-election at the beginning of this year, so he has a fundraising advantage right now. Plus we will be up against huge amounts of outside spending from right-wing super PACs.
So today, I am relying on a very large number of donations to help fund this campaign for the general election. It would mean a lot if you could add your donation today.
Please split a $25 contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood. I really need your support if we're going to defeat Ron Johnson and defend the Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes]
[http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes]
Back in 2018, we beat Scott Walker in Wisconsin with the highest midterm turnout on record – by bringing everyone together from every corner of the state. And that’s exactly how we are going to take the fight to Ron Johnson and win.
Since he's been in office, Ron Johnson has doubled his wealth as a result of the tax breaks that he fought for during Trump’s administration. And he even went so far as to complain that his wealth has only doubled – not quadrupled – during his time in Washington.
Ron Johnson is an out-of-touch millionaire who got elected only to serve himself.
I am running for U.S. Senate to rebuild the middle class and deliver opportunity for everyone. If elected, I’ll be the deciding vote to abolish the filibuster and defend abortion rights, address the climate crisis, and protect voting rights.
But whether or not I get that chance is up to people like you.
Like I said, this is going to be a very tough and competitive race. It will be one of the most closely-watched races in the entire country between now and November.
It takes a significant amount of resources to run a successful U.S. Senate campaign in a state as competitive as Wisconsin. If we're going to have what it takes to flip this seat, I'm going to need people like you to contribute what you can today.
So I am asking you again:
Can you please split a $25 contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin? We'll put your contribution immediately to work to flip this seat and defend the Democratic Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220810_CGVA_Barnes]
I've said from the start that this will be a people-powered campaign. And it has been very humbling to see all the people who are coming together to help send Ron Johnson packing.
Thank you so much for your support. As long as we are in this together, we are going to win.
All my best,
Mandela Barnes

name: EMERGENCY ALERT
subject: [ALERT] Almost 1,000 Rockets fired on Israel
body:
The Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town in Israel is on high alert!

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972178:JDBP8rVbN:m:1:3253819041:6F085001A6A2B5C2AC502CDAA54785CB:r "Headline") Peter: If you're following the news, you know this the people of Israel have endured a few tough days and more may be coming. The Iran-backed Islamic Jihad released a barrage of nearly 1000 rocket attacks targeting Israeli citizens. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972178:JDBP8rVbN:m:1:3253819041:6F085001A6A2B5C2AC502CDAA54785CB:r "Phone")**These rockets have been fired at Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and other Israeli cities. These attacks have taken place day and night, disrupting sleep for most Israelis who must seek immediate shelter.** **As I write you, the Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town is on high alert!** **These acts of terrorism are increasing by the day. Even when it's quiet after a cease-fire, the threat of more rockets and trauma from the past rockets remains. That 's why I am asking you to help us raise $45,798.25 by midnight tonight so we may:**
* Provide emergency aid backpacks for local Israeli security forces.
* Comfort terror victims suffering from PTSD especially young children.
* Care for soldiers who put their lives on the line to protect their people and the Land.

**[Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972178:JDBP8rVbN:m:1:3253819041:6F085001A6A2B5C2AC502CDAA54785CB:r "Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly
appreciated.")** We definitely need prayers, but we also need financial help so the Genesis123 Foundation can fulfill its mission and aid those who have suffered as a result of these rocket attacks. Most of Israel's youth (including my son) put their lives on the line defending the State of Israel and by playing a vital role in the War on Terror that threatens Israel, the United States, and our allies. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972178:JDBP8rVbN:m:1:3253819041:6F085001A6A2B5C2AC502CDAA54785CB:r "Soldiers")Unfortunately, often these soldiers do not have all the supplies they need, and often times their families have to buy them supplies out of their own pockets. Sadly, this isn't an option for soldiers who don't have family or the means to support them, so the Genesis 123 Foundation fills that gap while they keep defending Israel, safely and with dignity. During this Summer's extreme heatwave, one of the ways we help is to provide cold drinks, sweet watermelon and ice cream, and anything else we can, to help ease the soldiers' burdens. And let me tell you, these cool refreshments in the hot Summer sun are a well-received relief to these soldiers. **[Whether it's to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972178:JDBP8rVbN:m:1:3253819041:6F085001A6A2B5C2AC502CDAA54785CB:r "Whether it’s to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in
Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!")** Please prayerfully consider how you can help us take care of all the people affected by these Iranian-backed terror attacks. Don't delay. The next attack may occur in a matter of days as the Islamic Jihad is already threatening to break the ceasefire. The people of Israel need to be ready to respond to the emergencies and trauma that will result from the next attack, and that's why we need your generous support TODAY! Whether it's 10 or 1,000 rockets, the lives of innocent women and children are at risk. **We need to make sure the soldiers defending Israel have all they need, and we can provide other resources to Israelis who have suffered from these attacks.** **[Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000 today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a result of these terrorist attacks.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972178:JDBP8rVbN:m:1:3253819041:6F085001A6A2B5C2AC502CDAA54785CB:r "Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000
today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a
result of these terrorist attacks.")** Thank you again for your prayers and support. May God's blessings be upon Israel, Jonathan Feldstein
President, Genesis 123 Foundation

Hi team,

Now that August is here, Election Day is right around the corner — and many of us are feeling the pressure. This is THE most competitive district in New Jersey, and will be one of the closest House races in the entire country. We’re running to protect not only this seat, but our entire Congressional majority and our democracy along with it.

**But team, I have full faith in this team. This is not the first time we’ve faced a high pressure campaign — and thanks to your determination and your refusal to be complacent, we’ve risen to the occasion again and again. So I wanted to take a minute to remind you about everything we’ve ALREADY delivered together.**

Think about where we were when I first ran for Congress in 2018, not so long ago. The number one issue New Jerseyans were talking about was healthcare — it was too expensive, not accessible, and we had just narrowly avoided seeing the Affordable Care Act repealed. But because you helped elect our House majority, we protected healthcare access for millions of people. YOU did that, by voting in 2018.

And team, that’s just the tip of the iceberg. Because you stepped up to vote in 2018 and 2020, our Congressional majority passed the first gun violence prevention bill in decades this year. Because of you, our majority passed the single biggest investment in America’s infrastructure in decades — which is funding the Gateway Tunnel, fixing NJ Transit, upgrading our grid to clean energy, and paying for flood control to protect us from the next Hurricane Ida. And because of you, our majority passed the American Rescue Plan — which saved tens of millions of jobs and enabled our small towns and main street businesses to weather the pandemic – jobs and businesses that might otherwise have been lost for good.

Team – all that progress happened because of YOUR votes, activism, and financial support. And if we keep working hard, we’ll meet the next set of challenges, from codifying Roe vs. Wade, to tackling climate change, to protecting our elections.

It won’t be easy. **The GOP’s extremist arm is pouring millions of dollars to try to flip this seat — and install a MAGA puppet who has not announced a single plan to make life better for New Jerseyans, but has pledged that he “supports the Trump agenda” no matter what.** But if we keep working relentlessly in this final, critical push, we CAN defeat Kean Jr. and keep a responsible majority in power in Congress, to protect our democracy for all of us.

subject: Georgia Chamber of Commerce Endorses Burt Jones for Lieutenant Governor
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BURT JONES FOR GEORGIA, INC
body:

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 10, 2022
GEORGIA CHAMBER OF COMMERCE ENDORSES BURT JONES FOR LIEUTENANT GOVERNOR
JACKSON, Ga. - Today, the Georgia Chamber of Commerce, the state's leading business advocacy organization, endorsed Burt Jones for Lieutenant Governor. As a sixth-generation Georgia native and small business owner, Burt works with his family business, Jones Petroleum, as well as JP Capital & Insurance, a risk management company specializing in retail insurance brokerage. As a State Senator, Burt has been a champion for job creation and economic development, and will work with the Chamber as Lieutenant Governor to continue making Georgia the number one state to do business. This endorsement by the Georgia Chamber marks their first ever in an open race for Lieutenant Governor in Georgia.
---
|
---
| Burt Jones said, "I am honored to have the Georgia Chamber of Commerce's endorsement in our race for Lieutenant Governor. As a sixth-generation Georgia native and small business owner, I know firsthand how important it is to empower our private sector job creators, cut taxes and reduce burdensome regulations on small businesses, and put more money back into the pockets of hardworking Georgians. As a State Senator, I have been proud to work with the Georgia Chamber, a leading partner in our effort to make Georgia the number one state to do business eight years in a row. As Lieutenant Governor, I look forward to working with the business community to build on our state's economic success, invest in workforce development and our talent pipeline, and continue making Georgia the best state in the country to do business for generations to come."
---
| "The Georgia Chamber of Commerce and our statewide membership appreciate Burt Jones' record as a business leader as well as his service to his community as a member of the State Senate. His lifetime "A" rating with the Chamber during his tenure in the general assembly demonstrates that Senator Jones has prioritized economic growth and opportunity in Georgia," said David Raynor, Georgia Chamber Chief Public Affairs Officer. "The Georgia Chamber is proud to endorse pro-business candidates like Burt Jones and looks forward to continuing our great working relationship if elected."
---
| |
---
| About the Georgia Chamber of Commerce
As the state's largest business advocacy organization, the Georgia Chamber of Commerce represents investors in every county of our state with a diverse cross-selection of over 500 industry sectors. Our number one mission is keeping, growing, and creating jobs to make Georgia a better state for business. We work to ensure economic competitiveness, innovative solutions to challenges that state faces, and a commitment to high quality of life. For more visit, [gachamber.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FFAoJwPlYUhl50hy6GFZ5M9XvOIYWP_iUaL4xBw46h17JMSOu3IVjyGhWuf78paHc7d3SytzAwnGaAqffpCY5NKYe0sqfl5jSd8i2lF_ZRWeH2cSwep2_HegEjCLxPsT82e7Pg87Me-acghF55HvkA==&c=sCWQOu-DKZLpoXxEO9DNHiCtdO_qsm2HbG4Q3TPIqxmbgEPWbkNaLw==&ch=pTjw1UzN1UrJiRSIJNBtANCoDgaDpbNZynFd4i3p69fJ06V_ya8QEQ==)
---
| About Burt Jones
Burt Jones is a sixth-generation Georgia native, small business owner and currently serves as the State Senator for the 25th district. Burt owns JP Capital & Insurance, where he employs over one hundred Georgians. Burt went from walk-on to team captain of the University of Georgia's football team and was a member of the 2002 SEC Championship team. Burt resides in Jackson with his wife Jan and two children Stella and Banks.

Team,
I'm in between events, helping my team knock on doors around Pinellas County today, but this couldn't wait.
Here's the deal, folks – I have a quick question for you. What do you think a Republican-controlled Congress would do first?
I've been scared of this idea for a long time, and the answers are some of the reasons why I'm so determined to win this race in November. You could pick so many things from the right-wing priority list.
Banning abortions. Stopping any hope of action on climate change. Letting corporations price gouge our hard-earned savings. Ending Social Security and Medicare. Each one of their policy promises would devastate the lives of millions of Americans. We can't let that happen.
I don't like asking, team, but my finance director is telling us we may not have enough funds to get our message out to win this race.
Can you help us close this fundraising gap by chipping in whatever you can right now? subject: This is what they’re up to
body:
| | | [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=129d4422cd064aceb21c12016a7d3631&_e=CnL1HvCRu_mu2MjQrOis9U9sNybNqXlj7uU5h0G5i1DBaby0Olp1-ZQO5Wme0cUrHXkpe1RZMkDzMXDBJS_0KFmkBqwEDEmH-no4BByE846Tjoj9C4WdQHzAuxRc0gKEsX3fnyYqhWOrVLFQjz1QNqYGgAIP3BnzZVM_vBJ06kE_tQX3F27eLGOBhmuHj7DBV_x19tCgeEHdNDQGv7YWKEfPy2KBr3QhBYDr0OLqTdbo4tti_4YF81Du4vNVfUnGumzngun7iBE016K15HqPKHQChLrTbm2tcmzpS9SBBHo-xUVqxAccbQFWeu3rjnJre98ZBHwz3u-cWpgORlBb5Q%3D%3D)
---
Friend, The saying goes, if you're not paying for the product, you are the product.
Today, in Silicon Valley there is a group of tech oligarchs who view _you_ as _their_ product.
---
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=129d4422cd064aceb21c12016a7d3631&_e=CnL1HvCRu_mu2MjQrOis9U9sNybNqXlj7uU5h0G5i1DBaby0Olp1-ZQO5Wme0cUrHXkpe1RZMkDzMXDBJS_0KFmkBqwEDEmH-no4BByE846Tjoj9C4WdQHzAuxRc0gKEydHJ3-spJYbx7-C02zAWGyU8f9OUKxIUMGIFyyWLG8lPj_wr5vG2j4pJS7fnmtqsK9H0DQ_M2z10LbaonJ-bTDzqgj5a4rc-J04gtPwp6Kep9yIqsqoaMFE0bU8vhL5jEHpkDJiHO6iF4gjzdYchiuay5xImLd2uyvdRC1_DLbk92sUi66pdBHNNlZIhz49zyLKhlE_DNfhQjrL7NrG8Lg%3D%3D)
---
**Your habits.**
**Your location.**
**Your purchases.**
**Your data.**
**Your attention.**
Those are the SKUs that make up the economy of _YOU_.
And they are happy to buy and sell every part of your life they can find a way to monetize. All the while they pretend they are the heroes because they gave the user something “free.”
I learned a long time ago, and I’m betting you did too, that there is no such thing as a “free” lunch. That’s clearly true when it comes to the attention merchants spewing forth from Silicon Valley.
For every email platform they give away, for the brand new smart device they subsidize your purchase of, for every new subscription service they offer what they are really doing is finding another way to get a little bit more of you, your friends, and your family into their inventory.
**I am fighting for the people of Florida, not the Big Tech oligarchs in San Fransisco.** **[We the People have the power to fight back. We can fight back from the states and we can fight back from our homes.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=129d4422cd064aceb21c12016a7d3631&_e=CnL1HvCRu_mu2MjQrOis9U9sNybNqXlj7uU5h0G5i1DBaby0Olp1-ZQO5Wme0cUrHXkpe1RZMkDzMXDBJS_0KFmkBqwEDEmH-no4BByE846Tjoj9C4WdQHzAuxRc0gKEUmxE0jDTy5SxVdumBIvG56h0MjR389e6yP9phQDszdkFBUqDY7dqsNnk98CR7plPMuQFzOIGTeZhIcpC8CqOZDwUZAQ2TnlggeFebTKQSXX1ukwZ_vDgCEDU0147bJ3zz3ad7R2WfYNDOmCs12A2qoYzUbwCA-VMjJs7QJJFBCJZOZdKlnMeWLJWnJ58q1HSRKru8i9cUOyn53GIFT4CUg%3D%3D)**
---
It's no secret Big Tech is the unofficial censorship arm of the Democrat Machine--silencing any points of view that challenge their woke agenda and ideologies.
In Florida, we stood up to Big Tech and let them know Floridians would not be victims of their blatant and biased censorship of conservative voices.
**I signed into law legislation that holds Big Tech accountable by driving transparency and safeguarding Floridians ability to access and participate in online platforms without discrimination from the Leftist platforms.**
---
**[We can fight back.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=129d4422cd064aceb21c12016a7d3631&_e=CnL1HvCRu_mu2MjQrOis9U9sNybNqXlj7uU5h0G5i1DBaby0Olp1-ZQO5Wme0cUrHXkpe1RZMkDzMXDBJS_0KFmkBqwEDEmH-no4BByE846Tjoj9C4WdQHzAuxRc0gKEdT9P6Fj8TK7x7Sr5Vg8LXIKxV1olM7R9PjkxWmqsLWQZfZTYRv8M38RTgpxIIriV65NlUpA7SodNQRJb3zFz4AjM5l4lYtKMtjMiRvmiRzwEnhLMMrJdmxlCnvTfUTpJximl0XEKutRYUk45GOMHay9ETwzh6tiz7K090HxnWqNq4c9FsZkSMQThmdGU_SGX3jtfZD1fcWsnGjJyQ1jYrw%3D%3D)** And we must. Because the way that big tech has managed to protect it its business from the woke mob is by playing enforcer in the liberal narrative.
Even if their monetization of our attention wasn’t harmful and dangerous (_it is_). Even if they weren't being opaque about how they use consumer information (_they are_). Even if they were good stewards of the data they’re collecting (_they aren't_)...
There would still be the simple truth that they perpetuate an overriding liberal ideology and they work day and night to silence conservative voices.
Many of these companies claimed that their initial goal was to be open and inclusive. They even highlighted that as a core advantage over the legacy media. But the reality simply doesn't match the rhetoric.
If you disagree with the woke party line:
* _Plan to be shadow banned._
* _Plan to be de-platformed._
* _Plan to be erased from the public conversation._

Right now, you're reading this email on one of their platforms. The real question is, if I were not already Governor of Florida, would they even let you read it?
That question is being asked and answered millions of times a day by faceless tech giants who have no accountability to you or any of their other customers. They can censor with impunity. And they do.
The RNC for example has shown that every time an important fundraising deadline approaches one email platform diverts their messages away from the user and into the spam box.
**Big tech believes it decides what you should read. It decides who should be able to talk to you. It decides what you should think.**
This situation is untenable. The interests of big tech are not aligned with our citizens any more. This cannot stand. **[I am standing up and I have no intention of backing down.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=129d4422cd064aceb21c12016a7d3631&_e=CnL1HvCRu_mu2MjQrOis9U9sNybNqXlj7uU5h0G5i1DBaby0Olp1-ZQO5Wme0cUrHXkpe1RZMkDzMXDBJS_0KFmkBqwEDEmH-no4BByE846Tjoj9C4WdQHzAuxRc0gKEAhs8adqM9UTmMekJVMqlQHjlk3ErMINsBiUOQ_BuTOoY4lMD9uKXMEi-DlRbni-9xLQD8UeyuPi84uNb7VU6GG8BtMH4ardeuRc4fQhdiLE4hOIZ8KLutidVgiPO2B_MRuGOQ5E7fghLPJZYZosov3gqKgOJTvXeoSTRGvLreYY6_qRa4vEoq_W7tc3xI2rVd6tM8eh3nQZ9fXUpJ4PoSg%3D%3D)**
Big tech has already come for me. I have no doubts that they will come again. I want you to be in this fight with me. **[Make a donation today, show Big Tech that you will stand up against censorship. Show Big Tech that your beliefs will not corrupted. Show Big Tech that conservatives cannot and will not be silenced in America.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=129d4422cd064aceb21c12016a7d3631&_e=CnL1HvCRu_mu2MjQrOis9U9sNybNqXlj7uU5h0G5i1DBaby0Olp1-ZQO5Wme0cUrHXkpe1RZMkDzMXDBJS_0KFmkBqwEDEmH-no4BByE846Tjoj9C4WdQHzAuxRc0gKEL6x_xPMVZgdnouuSE5_iZbvx-gv38W2S4KvIYAbRfPpgrmCsDb8lKtVeyswGUUk8z5nRXOd1luCPlyld91wCNXPfGoq9bPq-372pgF2wn2numyFSrI-3k6rdM8KQOer7E8SyzF-UM_yQUBiklNAsuxfTYYjBjbDny4NBN9LVcORXE6xyTK3ohdRpbgCtVHcwNgCLUQWJ0R3k9OHLN7jiZw%3D%3D)**
I am ready to fight them in Florida. I need your help to do it.

clean_body: | | | Friend, The saying goes, if you're not paying for the product, you are the product. Today, in Silicon Valley there is a group of tech oligarchs who view you as their product. Your habits. Your location. Your purchases. Your data. Your attention. Those are the SKUs that make up the economy of YOU. And they are happy to buy and sell every part of your life they can find a way to monetize. All the while they pretend they are the heroes because they gave the user something “free.” I learned a long time ago, and I’m betting you did too, that there is no such thing as a “free” lunch. That’s clearly true when it comes to the attention merchants spewing forth from Silicon Valley. For every email platform they give away, for the brand new smart device they subsidize your purchase of, for every new subscription service they offer what they are really doing is finding another way to get a little bit more of you, your friends, and your family into their inventory. I am fighting for the people of Florida, not the Big Tech oligarchs in San Fransisco. It's no secret Big Tech is the unofficial censorship arm of the Democrat Machine--silencing any points of view that challenge their woke agenda and ideologies. In Florida, we stood up to Big Tech and let them know Floridians would not be victims of their blatant and biased censorship of conservative voices. I signed into law legislation that holds Big Tech accountable by driving transparency and safeguarding Floridians ability to access and participate in online platforms without discrimination from the Leftist platforms. And we must. Because the way that big tech has managed to protect it its business from the woke mob is by playing enforcer in the liberal narrative. Even if their monetization of our attention wasn’t harmful and dangerous (it is). Even if they weren't being opaque about how they use consumer information (they are). Even if they were good stewards of the data they’re collecting (they aren't)... There would still be the simple truth that they perpetuate an overriding liberal ideology and they work day and night to silence conservative voices. Many of these companies claimed that their initial goal was to be open and inclusive. They even highlighted that as a core advantage over the legacy media. But the reality simply doesn't match the rhetoric. If you disagree with the woke party line: Plan to be shadow banned. Plan to be de-platformed. Plan to be erased from the public conversation. Right now, you're reading this email on one of their platforms. The real question is, if I were not already Governor of Florida, would they even let you read it? That question is being asked and answered millions of times a day by faceless tech giants who have no accountability to you or any of their other customers. They can censor with impunity. And they do. The RNC for example has shown that every time an important fundraising deadline approaches one email platform diverts their messages away from the user and into the spam box. Big tech believes it decides what you should read. It decides who should be able to talk to you. It decides what you should think. This situation is untenable. The interests of big tech are not aligned with our citizens any more. This cannot stand. Big tech has already come for me. I have no doubts that they will come again. I want you to be in this fight with me. ** I am ready to fight them in Florida. I need your help to do it. | | | | | Ron DeSantis | | | | | | Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor | | Sent to Conservatives Give subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Wade Herring for Congress
body:
https://www.wadeherringforcongress.com/ [https://www.wadeherringforcongress.com/]
Peter,
Yesterday, Susan and I traveled to Brunswick, Georgia for a street dedication ceremony to remember and honor Ahmaud Arbery.
In February 2020, Mr. Arbery was shot and killed while jogging. His killers were convicted of murder and federal hate crimes. Mr. Arbery’s death, along with the other killings of unarmed Black people such as George Floyd and Breonna Taylor, spurred protests across the nation in 2020.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/ahmaud%20edit_edit.jpg]
Attorney Lee Merritt speaking at the ceremony with Wanda Cooper-Jones, Mr. Arbery's mother, beside him.
Yesterday’s ceremony was not only to honor Mr. Arbery’s life but also to remember the changes brought about in Brunswick, the state, and the country.
Wanda Cooper-Jones, Mr. Arbery’s mother, said, “I look at the change Ahmaud has brought since his passing.”
In the wake of Mr. Arbery’s death, Georgia adopted a hate crimes law imposing additional penalties for crimes motivated by a victim’s race, religion, sexual orientation, or other factors. And, state lawmakers gutted an 1863 state law authorizing private citizens to make arrests, which Mr. Arbery’s pursuers had sought to use to justify the deadly chase.
I was humbled to be at Ahmaud Arbery’s street dedication yesterday and to witness the impact of Mr. Arbery’s life and death, the sadness & anger that his community experienced, and the courage of his family to keep fighting for justice and what is right.
I hope we can let this be a reminder of where we have been, the progress we have made, and how far we still have to go.
Ms. Cooper-Jones asked that we always remember her son’s name. Long live Ahmaud Arbery.
In service,
Wade Herring

body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Eucli

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3t9gmjo8uku1laq16lis1g1qu35h2d9ods87ddo_rp22sh2s8i66or0chgm9o36cth2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend,
Days ago, the Senate passed the Inflation Reduction Act, a bill that will allocate critical resources to address the energy needs in our country. From solar to wind, estimates are that we can triple our clean energy production and reduce carbon emissions by 40% before 2030.
This legislation will cut costs and open doors for countless Oklahomans. Experts believe that some households could save $150 each month. For millions of families across the country, $150 is enough to cover a family’s grocery bill or gas to take their kid to school.
Instead of voting for price-relieving solutions for Americans, James Lankford voted NO.
Lankford stood on the Senate floor and cherry-picked parts of the bill that he disagreed with, versus his obligation to serve people. He griped about the excessive spending, yet the sum of these costs added up to less than 2% of the total bill.
We know all bills are not perfect, however, Lankford continues to overlook any benefits in bills and kneel down for party politics to impede and revert advancement for the American people.
I am running to solve problems and collaborate on bills to move Oklahoma and America forward.
Will you donate $5, $10, $20 or even $100 today?
Chip in today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh]
Advancement isn’t perfect, it’s incremental, and we must continue to offer solutions, versus playing games with the lives of everyday people.
Thank you for your continued support. The runoff is less than 2 weeks away, see you at the polls!
Let's get to work!
Madison

| | | Peter,
_Did you know that nearly 38 MILLION acres of U.S. farmland are owned by foreigners?_

_Did you know that CHINA has been one of the biggest investors in U.S. farmland,__as they seek to overtake us with regards to our military and our economy?_
The numbers are truly alarming.

And today, Alabama has the THIRD MOST foreign-owned land in the nation!

I’m raising the alarm and taking action. We cannot continue giving our top adversary a foot in the door to undermine our national security.

**Last week, Senator Tom Cotton and I introduced the _Securing America’s Land from Foreign Interference Act_ to STOP the Chinese Communist Party from buying our land.**
[**FOLLOW THIS LINK**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/87546545fbc66e23/0aa35fcc507157e7c3d6b838967d376c/33013)[**TO READ MORE ON OUR BILL >>>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/87546545fbc66e23/e981841040b0fab3c3d6b838967d376c/33013)
It’s vital that we protect our agricultural industry and food supply chain.

_Chinese holdings in U.S. agriculture _**surged by more than 2,700% between 2010 and 2020**_ , and there are no signs that they’re slowing down!_

I’m urging Congress to take swift action and I’ll be counting on your support in this fight.

[**Take just a few minutes now to read more on this critical legislation.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/87546545fbc66e23/8383bb83852c87c6c3d6b838967d376c/33013)

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/votetylerlee/congresswoman-adams-lawless-behavior-7339797?e=4ed8243e91)
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/persecution-by-the-swamp?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=080996ad51-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-080996ad51-617881201
Fellow Patriot,
The FBI’s raid on President Trump’s home at Mar-A-Lago bodes as ominous signs of a federal government more focused on the power to wield than to protect!

The audacity to engage such unprecedented force against a former President after a non-ending barrage of attacks while he served is flagrantly corrupt and speaks to the obsession the DC Swamp has for a man whose sole aim was to serve the American people!

Conservatives are under attack and they are coming for us all. Enough is Enough!
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/persecution-by-the-swamp?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=080996ad51-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-080996ad51-617881201
Big Tech censorship, a gazillion IRS agents, and embedded FBI insurgents in our peaceful protests cannot and WILL NOT triumph over our Conservative movement!

Americans see the deceitful duplicity of deep state agents who turn a blind eye to Hunter Biden’s
Laptop From Hell, Hillary Clinton’s 33,000 deleted emails with the ‘What Difference Does It Make’ elitist demeanor, Joe Biden’s outrageous negligence in Afghanistan that resulted in the disgraceful loss of 13 military service members, all while parents are being labeled as ‘domestic terrorists’ for speaking up at board meetings by the current administration!

Nothing can stop what is coming for the DC Swamp after election day!

Let’s end this shameful era of deep state power once and for all. To do so, we must elect patriotic Americans who will stand up and reject any endeavors to take aim on the citizenry after they attempt to immobilize Conservatives across the country.

As your next Congressman, I will defend Americans against weaponized government attacks against its own people. Together we will triumph over the evil that has taken root in the institutions that were established to protect the Americans, splinter them into 1,000 pieces, and scatter the refuse into the winds of yesteryear!

Join me in the fight to deliver a decisive defeat to the DC Swamp by supporting my campaign with a generous donation of any amount today:

subject: I'm the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin

body:
We can win this race, as long as we're in it together.
| It's official, team:

I am now the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, and the race to take on Ron Johnson starts now.

In order to flip this seat in November, I'm relying on an unprecedented grassroots movement to defeat Ron Johnson.

I cannot do this alone.

Wisconsin's Senate race is one of the most important races in the entire country this year. Because defending the Democratic Senate majority depends on what happens in Wisconsin.

So I'm asking you directly:

[**Can you please split $5 between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Voter Protection Project? Every contribution - no matter how large or small - will ensure our campaign has the resources to flip this seat.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21528?t=6&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Mandela Barnes and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21529?t=7&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21530?t=8&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21531?t=9&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21532?t=10&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21533?t=11&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)
I was born and raised in Milwaukee. I don't come from a wealthy or well-connected family. But I do come from a proud union family.

My mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years, and my dad worked 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were my family's ticket to the middle class.

My parents spent their days organizing for better wages and advancing workers' rights. Their example showed me the importance of coming together around shared values and fighting for opportunity for everyone.

The current system isn't working for people in Wisconsin and across the country. Hard work just isn't paying off like it used to. People are working longer and longer for less and less while big corporations and CEOs bring in larger profits than ever before.

That's why we can't settle for what is - we have to reach for what can be.

Now that we are up against Ron Johnson, we will be facing some very powerful special interest groups and right-wing super PACs that want to stop our campaign.

They will pour tens of millions of dollars into negative ads to try to defeat me and prop up Ron Johnson. The truth is that they will stop at nothing to defend this seat.

So we need to be ready for whatever they will throw our way, which means I am relying on lots of people making contributions to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and defend the Senate majority.

[**Can you please split $5 between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Voter Protection Project? We'll put your contribution immediately to work to win this race.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21528?t=12&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)
As long as we are in this together, there is no limit to what we can accomplish.

Thank you for adding your contribution today.

All my best,

Mandela Barnes
[SPLIT $5 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/21533?t=13&akid=4032%2E878179%2ExgBagv)

Will you add your name to our petition?
Hey there – Did you catch Karen's last message?

A week ago, Kansans proved to the country what many of us already knew – reproductive rights are human rights, and we will fight to protect them.

Rick Caruso is a longtime Republican who has a long track record of supporting anti-choice Republicans and organizations. He’s donated hundreds of thousands of dollars to their causes. Meanwhile, Karen Bass has spent her entire life fighting for reproductive rights. Los Angeles deserves a leader who will defend a woman’s right to choose.

**[Stand up for the most vulnerable in Los Angeles and protect the right to choice, contraception, and privacy. Add your name next to Karen’s if you're with her in making sure our city is a safe haven for reproductive freedom.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49041045/360605422/-345238720?ms=em22_220809_Choice_adv_gq_act_pet_TB_ettx&refcode=em22_220809_Choice_adv_gq_act_pet_TB_ettx&source=em22_220809_Choice_adv_gq_act_pet_TB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220809_Choice_adv_gq_act_pet_TB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=8iLe28A5Yv7b8rulSGlHoV%2FecF%2BVRitTvkNhFodpHSBKsqEW%2FhL50fsOAI8VnHuWf9afPPa7inT4X9JRVDxi4csSii9B%2Bvr3639wcQPqCsnJzSP4A6wz5iYJCLJjXV87wFhmcJ4Y0HaYYdQuPfFICQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzNjODcwNC1kMDE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qqjurKgM7MOTfrj7X18Iz1ESFg7p6UUQnAS3RIy60AY=&emci=5d4d8d77-f417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=bc3c8704-d018-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)**

Team Bass
