body:
The Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town in Israel is on high alert!

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972218:Jgf3IrVNl:m:1:3334294963:D06160913F501AAEAE79AA6E4F160D2D:r "Headline") Peter: If you're following the news, you know this the people of Israel have endured a few tough days and more may be coming. The Iran-backed Islamic Jihad released a barrage of nearly 1000 rocket attacks targeting Israeli citizens. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972218:Jgf3IrVNl:m:1:3334294963:D06160913F501AAEAE79AA6E4F160D2D:r "Phone")**These rockets have been fired at Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and other Israeli cities. These attacks have taken place day and night, disrupting sleep for most Israelis who must seek immediate shelter.** **As I write you, the Red Alert app on my phone is sounding feverishly. Town after town is on high alert!** **These acts of terrorism are increasing by the day. Even when it's quiet after a cease-fire, the threat of more rockets and trauma from the past rockets remains. That 's why I am asking you to help us raise $45,798.25 by midnight tonight so we may:**
* Provide emergency aid backpacks for local Israeli security forces.
* Comfort terror victims suffering from PTSD especially young children.
* Care for soldiers who put their lives on the line to protect their people and the Land.

**[Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972218:Jgf3IrVNl:m:1:3334294963:D06160913F501AAEAE79AA6E4F160D2D:r "Please donate $25, $50, or even $100 and help us provide these
emergency supplies to those in need. A blessing in ANY AMOUNT is greatly appreciated.")** We definitely need prayers, but we also need financial help so the Genesis123 Foundation can fulfill its mission and aid those who have suffered as a result of these rocket attacks. Most of Israel's youth (including my son) put their lives on the line defending the State of Israel and by playing a vital role in the War on Terror that threatens Israel, the United States, and our allies. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972218:Jgf3IrVNl:m:1:3334294963:D06160913F501AAEAE79AA6E4F160D2D:r "Soldiers")Unfortunately, often these soldiers do not have all the supplies they need, and often times their families have to buy them supplies out of their own pockets. Sadly, this isn't an option for soldiers who don't have family or the means to support them, so the Genesis 123 Foundation fills that gap while they keep defending Israel, safely and with dignity. During this Summer's extreme heatwave, one of the ways we help is to provide cold drinks, sweet watermelon and ice cream, and anything else we can, to help ease the soldiers' burdens. And let me tell you, these cool refreshments in the hot Summer sun are a well-received relief to these soldiers. **[Whether it's to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972218:Jgf3IrVNl:m:1:3334294963:D06160913F501AAEAE79AA6E4F160D2D:r "Whether it’s to help us provide cold refreshments or life-saving medical equipment, we need your help to serve people and soldiers in
Israel. Please stand with us today as we provide emergency supplies to those in need with your tax-deductible donation of $50, $100, or $250 today!")** Please prayerfully consider how you can help us take care of all the people affected by these Iranian-backed terror attacks. Don't delay. The next attack may occur in a matter of days as the Islamic Jihad is already threatening to break the ceasefire. The people of Israel need to be ready to respond to the emergencies and trauma that will result from the next attack, and that's why we need your generous support TODAY! Whether it's 10 or 1,000 rockets, the lives of innocent women and children are at risk. **We need to make sure the soldiers defending Israel have all they need, and we can provide other resources to Israelis who have suffered from these attacks.** **[Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000 today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a result of these terrorist attacks.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60972218:Jgf3IrVNl:m:1:3334294963:D06160913F501AAEAE79AA6E4F160D2D:r "Your donation of $100, $500, or even $1000
today will make the key difference in our ability to fulfill our mission with supplies and provide counseling to those Israelis who need the help as a
result of these terrorist attacks.")** Thank you again for your prayers and support. May God's blessings be upon Israel, Jonathan Feldstein
President, Genesis 123 Foundation

| | Here's what we learned from the Kansas abortion referendum:
* Despite what the Supreme Court thinks, voters overwhelmingly do NOT want extreme abortion bans.
* **Voters are fired up and ready to mobilize in local elections this year, because they know that critical issues – like abortion rights and elections certifications – will be decided by state legislatures.**

Now, state Democrats everywhere are taking these lessons and turning them into action. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: My opponent’s 5 votes against MI jobs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220810 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220810]
Team,
The next generation of cars should be built here in Michigan. It’s why I’ve focused on bringing supply chains back from overseas and putting taxpayer money towards American companies – not China.
In the state legislature, my opponent voted *five times* against the bipartisan deal to support 5,000 good-paying auto jobs in mid-Michigan – including a brand new auto plant in Delta Township (which is in his own backyard!).
That clear contrast between us is the focus of my new ad, which you can watch below:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220810 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220810]
All told, he has voted to oppose close to $10 billion in private investment into Michigan’s auto industry and over 8,000 Michigan auto jobs. He called the bipartisan agreements that created these jobs “corporate welfare,” without offering any alternative proposal or vision.
Thousands of jobs. Gone.
Securing American supply chains and rebuilding domestic manufacturing has been one of my main priorities in Congress. For the past two years, my work has been dominated by the on-and-off closures of auto plants in my district that can’t get their hands on a 14-cent microchip. It’s why I was such a strong proponent of the CHIPS Act which was recently signed into law. It’s a bipartisan piece of legislation that will provide incentives for companies to manufacture the microchips right here in the U.S. and create tens of thousands of jobs in the industrial Midwest.
I hope you’ll give the ad a watch, and that you’ll consider chipping in to my campaign. This is the most competitive House race in Michigan, and one of the ten most competitive in the country. Your contributions help me run these ads, which helps me spread this message to the voters of the new 7th district. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220810]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220810]
Thanks for watching!
Elissa

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
I wanted to personally share some incredible news
| | |
---
Friend, I'm reaching out because I wanted to personally share some incredible news:
After polls showed me trailing Marco Rubio by a few points _for months_ , a brand-new poll just came out on Monday: **It's 45-45. We're officially tied with Rubio in a race that could decide Senate control.**
I couldn't have done this without you, but now I need you more than ever.
As you read this, Mitch McConnell and the GOP are gearing up to pour millions into this race to bombard us with nonstop attack ads from now until Election Day. **That's because the GOP knows that if I defeat Rubio, it will virtually guarantee that Democrats keep Senate control. **

**But Mastriano didn’t answer a single question — and he walked out after just 15 minutes.**

Mastriano was present at the Jan. 6, 2021 insurrection at the U.S. Capitol and walked past police barricades set up to keep the rioters at bay. Mastriano also spent thousands to bus in rioters who later stormed the Capitol. At least five of his supporters were even arrested that day. But now Mastriano is refusing to answer questions – what is he afraid of?

Mastriano was subpoenaed by the committee – and interviewed by the FBI – and now the January 6th Committee is showing the American public exactly how Trump and his allies (like Mastriano) actively tried to overturn our democracy.

I was born and raised in Milwaukee. I don’t come from a wealthy or well-connected family. But I do come from a proud union family.

My mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years, and my dad worked 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were my family's ticket to the middle class.
My parents spent their days organizing for better wages and advancing workers' rights. Their example showed me the importance of coming together around shared values and fighting for opportunity for everyone.

The current system isn't working for people in Wisconsin and across the country. Hard work just isn't paying off like it used to. People are working longer and longer for less and less while big corporations and CEOs bring in larger profits than ever before.
That's why we can't settle for what is – we have to reach for what can be.

Now that we are up against Ron Johnson, we will be facing some very powerful special interest groups and right-wing super PACs that want to stop our campaign.
They will pour tens of millions of dollars into negative ads to try to defeat me and prop up Ron Johnson. The truth is that they will stop at nothing to defend this seat.

Our individual liberties have been trounced and continue to be under constant threat from authoritarians running the show in D.C. and President Biden and VP Harris clearly do NOT have a grip on the power they wield. . | Peter, It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier. But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever. Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers. And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist. This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Peter – I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values. But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington. Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream. Right now, Democrats are... Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America. Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable. Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers. The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House THIS November. My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. This will not be an easy road, which is why I am reaching out to you. I will need the financial support of every American patriot; every single dollar will help. God Bless, Alek Skarlatos Alek Skarlatos Republican for Congress | Alek is a former Oregon National Guardsman, completing a nine-month deployment in Afghanistan. body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49060828/360662637/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZDM4MTQ2LTA1MTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qJXtux9av5_rZxBCgRc_8AFEAmpY5zMJ0yOGK6uBO_o=&emci=e7917c2c-f118-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8d38146-0519-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) | | | Hi there, I'm checking back in because the future of our country is at stake. As soon as Friday, the U.S. House of Representatives could vote on the Inflation Reduction Act: the most thorough investment in environmental justice, clean energy, and the fight against climate change our nation has seen. **[We must act immediately to pass this bill.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49060829/360662638/-199227681?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZDM4MTQ2LTA1MTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qJXtux9av5_rZxBCgRc_8AFEAmpY5zMJ0yOGK6uBO_o=&emci=e7917c2c-f118-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8d38146-0519-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** If passed, this bill would make a MASSIVE dent in our pollution levels, fund strong renewable infrastructure, and create millions of jobs, so we can't let it be killed by House Republicans or any holdouts— **[send a message urging your representative to vote "YES" on the Inflation Reduction Act now!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49060830/360662639/-199227681?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZDM4MTQ2LTA1MTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qJXtux9av5_rZxBCgRc_8AFEAmpY5zMJ0yOGK6uBO_o=&emci=e7917c2c-f118-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8d38146-0519-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** Thank you for always caring about our planet! Lindsey Scholten, Deputy Director, OLCV ––––– FORWARD ––––– Hi there, Amazing news— the Inflation Reduction Act, and the crucial climate provisions it holds have successfully passed the U.S. Senate! Now, it’s headed towards a vote from the U.S. House of Representatives. _We’re so close, and have come so far. Help us get this historic climate bill across the finish line this week.__**[Will you send a message to your U.S. representative urging them to fight for our climate by voting “yes” on the Inflation Reduction Act?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49060831/360662640/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZDM4MTQ2LTA1MTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qJXtux9av5_rZxBCgRc_8AFEAmpY5zMJ0yOGK6uBO_o=&emci=e7917c2c-f118-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8d38146-0519-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**_ This bill represents a major turning point in the battle for our country’s climate. As Senate Majority Leader Schumer announced, it has the potential to shave down carbon emissions in the United States by as much as 40% by 2030. One way this bill would accomplish this is by investing more in creating clean, renewable energy sources on U.S. soil. This will create reliable networks of emission-free power that can sustain our infrastructure through drastic climate-induced weather events _WHILE_ saving Americans countless dollars on energy bills. _**[We need you to ask your representative to pass the bill right away to make room for clean energy and the economic benefits that accompany it.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49060832/360662641/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZDM4MTQ2LTA1MTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qJXtux9av5_rZxBCgRc_8AFEAmpY5zMJ0yOGK6uBO_o=&emci=e7917c2c-f118-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8d38146-0519-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**_ In addition, the game-changing climate pieces of the Inflation Reduction Act will create **millions** of jobs in the production of clean energy and climate-friendly infrastructure, benefitting our national economy as well as BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, and People of Color) and low-income communities who need a federal commitment to environmental justice the most. Some skeptics have expressed apprehension about flaws in the bill, noting that it isn’t as hard on fossil fuel companies as it should be, and we agree this bill is not perfect. Yet despite its imperfections, the Inflation Reduction Act tackles climate change and environmental justice at a scale we haven’t seen before. Climate change will only get worse if urgent action isn’t taken immediately, so _**[we must contact the House of Representatives and push them to do everything in their power to pass this bill.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49060833/360662642/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4ZDM4MTQ2LTA1MTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qJXtux9av5_rZxBCgRc_8AFEAmpY5zMJ0yOGK6uBO_o=&emci=e7917c2c-f118-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8d38146-0519-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**_ Thank you for never giving up! Lindsey Scholten, Deputy Director, OLCV. |

name: Team AOC
subject: Share your thoughts with us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
With less than 90 days until Election Day, we want to make sure our priorities continue to be aligned with yours.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220810-3288-header&t=1&akid=3288%2E2526796%2EF_dWvz)
Yesterday marked 90 days until Election Day. There’s still a ton of work ahead, but with your support, we’re feeling more hopeful and confident than ever.
Over the last several months, Alexandria has been leading in Capitol Hill on many issues from climate justice to banning stock trading in Congress. Many of these issues are based on the priorities you shared with us in January. Now, with less than 90 days until Election Day, we want to make sure our priorities continue to be aligned with yours.
[Will you take two minutes of your time today to take our Mid-Year Priorities Survey and share with us what matters most to you going into this midterm election?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/2022-mid-year-priorities/?source=em20220810-3288-P_FND_ANO_MIS&t=2&akid=3288%2E2526796%2EF_dWvz)
**[Take the survey »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/2022-mid-year-priorities/?source=em20220810-3288-P_FND_ANO_MIS&t=3&akid=3288%2E2526796%2EF_dWvz)**
On a grassroots campaign like ours, it's crucial for our team to hear from all of you as often as possible to learn about the issues impacting you and your family.
Knowing what’s important to you helps us fight for legislation in Congress that will support working people most.
These periodic surveys we send also allow us to see how priorities have shifted in the past couple months. Last time we checked in, most people said abolishing the filibuster, and fighting climate change with a Green New Deal were their top concerns.
[Now, we hope you’ll take two minutes today to share with us what matters most to you as we go into our upcoming election. Click here to take the survey »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/2022-mid-year-priorities/?source=em20220810-3288-P_FND_ANO_MIS&t=4&akid=3288%2E2526796%2EF_dWvz)
We’re so grateful for your continued support of our movement.
Thank you for being with us,
Team AOC

Hello,
My team just wrapped up an emergency fundraising meeting. Chuck Grassley has already started smearing me across the entire state with attack ads, and Mitch McConnell is raising millions more to stop me from turning Iowa blue.
But with less than 36 hours until our critical fundraising deadline, we just checked ActBlue – and our grassroots fundraising has slowed way down. **If I’m going to send Chuck Grassley packing and protect our Democratic Senate majority, I’m counting on a new surge of donations from people like you now.**
The polling shows Grassley has never been more vulnerable, and we’re gaining ground. But Iowa was one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2020, and it’ll be even closer this year. | **NFIB Endorses Jeremy Shaffer for Congress (PA-17)**
---
| **McKees Rocks, PA** – The National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB), the nation’s leading small business advocacy organization, today endorsed Jeremy Shaffer in Pennsylvania’s 17th Congressional District. The endorsement was announced at a campaign event this morning held at NFIB member business Cranston Material Handling Equipment in McKees Rocks.

"As a former small business owner, Jeremy Shaffer understands the challenges of operating a small business," said **Greg Moreland, NFIB Pennsylvania State Director**. "He recognizes the harm burdensome government regulations and mandates can have on a small business and has pledged to advocate for pro-small business policies. Jeremy Shaffer will be a strong voice for Pennsylvania’s small businesses, and we look forward to working with him."

"Jeremy Shaffer will be a strong small business ally in Congress," said **Sharon Sussin, NFIB Senior National Political Director**. "We are confident he will advocate for Pennsylvania’s small businesses, and we are pleased to endorse him today."

"NFIB represents thousands of small businesses here in Western Pennsylvania, and it's an honor to earn their support," said **Jeremy Shaffer**. "As a small business owner myself, I am very familiar with the issues important to the independent job-creators across PA-17 and our nation. In Congress, I'll be a champion for pro-growth policies so businesses can thrive and create meaningful jobs that fuel our Western Pennsylvania economy."
---
|
---
_Left: David Cranston Jr, President of Cranston Material Handling Equipment Corporation. Right: Jeremy Shaffer. Photo taken this morning during company tour._

| | **Dark money. ****No one knows who is behind it or where it came from.** And there are no limits on how much a billionaire or a corporation can spend influencing our elections. This is a major problem for our democracy. **Since the disastrous _Citizens United_ decision, there has been billions of dollars in dark money flowing in our elections and corrupting our political system. ** Each election, billionaires and corporate special interests dump gobs of money into super PACs with innocuous-sounding names. In truth, these super PACs are the mechanism by which the uber-wealthy _buy elections._ But for people like you and me, if we donate $200 to a campaign, that money is disclosed. But if a Wall Street billionaire or corporation spends five or ten million in support of a campaign, they don't have to disclose the contribution. It's absurd. **That's why I've joined my good friend Senator Whitehouse in working to pass the DISCLOSE Act and finally shine a bright light on the dark money in our political process. We just held a hearing on the DISCLOSE ACT recently in the Senate, and it's my hope we can get it to the floor for a vote soon.** The DISCLOSE Act will require billionaires and corporations to disclose their massive campaign contributions so that the American people know where the money is coming from and the motivation behind it. For years, I've been fighting to restore election integrity to make sure Americans have full access to the ballot box. But election integrity also means that the American people know where all the campaign spending is coming from. **Dark money is a plague on our politics and a great way to cure it is to pass the clean_body: | | | | Dark money. No one knows who is behind it or where it came from. And there are no limits on how much a billionaire or a corporation can spend influencing our elections. This is a major problem for our democracy. Since the disastrous Citizens United decision, there has been billions of dollars in dark money flowing in our elections and corrupting our political system. Each election, billionaires and corporate special interests dump gobs of money into super PACs with innocuous-sounding names. In truth, these super PACs are the mechanism by which the uber-wealthy buy elections. But for people like you and me, if we donate $200 to a campaign, that money is disclosed. But if a Wall Street billionaire or corporation spends five or ten million in support of a campaign, they don't have to disclose the contribution. It's absurd. That's why I've joined my good friend Senator Whitehouse in working to pass the DISCLOSE Act and finally shine a bright light on the dark money in our political process. We just held a hearing on the DISCLOSE ACT recently in the Senate, and it's my hope we can get it to the floor for a vote soon. The DISCLOSE Act will require billionaires and corporations to disclose their massive campaign contributions so that the American people know where the money is coming from and the motivation behind it. For years, I've been fighting to restore election integrity to make sure Americans have full access to the ballot box. But election integrity also means that the American people know where all the campaign spending is coming from. Dark money is a plague on our politics and a great way to cure it is to pass the DISCLOSE Act. subject: 10 things about me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

My name is Charles Booker, and I’m running for the U.S. Senate to
represent Kentucky against Rand Paul.

Our election is coming up in a few short months and I know there are a lot
of new folks who just joined our team – so I wanted to reach out to
introduce myself. 👋

As a born-and-raised Kentuckian, running for this seat isn’t just politics
to me. It’s a very personal decision, and I want to share with you a bit
about my story and why I’m the best person to fight for you and your
family. My story is Kentucky’s story. It’s a story of perseverance, faith,
and overcoming impossible obstacles.

I’m proud to share my story with you today. But before I get to that, I
have a favor to ask:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220810.UwuSn3&refcode=em20220810-2345&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=2345%2E346206%2ExDGn0T ]I hope you can chip in $5 or anything you can to help us raise $10,000
today. We’re only months away from the election, and we want this campaign
to be in the strongest place possible.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220810.UwuSn3&refcode=em20220810-2345&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=2345%2E346206%2ExDGn0T ]Contribute $5 →

Peter, as a
part of this campaign, here are 10 things I want you to know about me:

1. I was born and raised in Louisville’s West End, one of the poorest ZIP
codes in Kentucky. Both of my parents had to drop out of high school to
help take care of my brothers and sisters. We sometimes had to go without
heat in the winter or air conditioning in the summer. My mom often went
without eating so that I could. These experiences inspired me to work in
public service and fight for the change our communities urgently need.

2. I got involved in public service because I believed Kentuckians
deserved better and that things could get better. When I was first elected
to the State House, I became the youngest Black legislator in Kentucky in
90 years. As a legislator, I fought for common sense gun discipline, lower
prescription drug costs, expanded voting rights, stronger labor unions,
and racial justice. And all around me, I started seeing evidence that
change is possible.

3. In 2020, I decided to take my fight for a better Kentucky to Mitch
McConnell. We built a ground-breaking movement. Our neighbors from the
hood to the holler rose up and together we showed the world that Kentucky
is a battleground state.

4. I saw how hungry Kentuckians were for bold change in that election so
shortly afterwards I founded Hood to the Holler — an organization focused
on community engagement and breaking down the barriers that have prevented
so many Kentuckians from participating in our election.

5. I’m a proud girl dad of three daughters. I want a future for them where
the color of her skin doesn’t determine their chances of experiencing
police violence. A future where they can breathe clean air, get a college
education without going into crippling debt, and not know what it’s like
to go to bed hungry. It’s a future we all want for our children.

6. Our politicians don’t represent us. The Kentucky that I know and love
is kind and hard-working. We showed up for each other to provide love and
support when the pandemic hit, and we were there for our neighbors when
the floodwaters rose and a storm knocked the power out. Our politicians,
though, they’re nowhere to be found. They’re voting to take away our
health care and basic relief in the middle of a pandemic. All the while
Rand Paul is just trying to make a profit off this pandemic and spreading
deadly misinformation.

7. I believe we can redefine our politics by replacing the old Southern
Strategy with a new one that lifts love and unity over hate and division.
We believe in a movement that ends structural inequity and breaks the
cycle of generational poverty. We believe Kentucky can thrive when we lift
up the voices of hardworking people from the forgotten places, and build a
new coalition of people from the hood to the holler

8. I’m proud to support Medicare for All so we can finally transform our
broken health care system. I nearly died three years ago because I
couldn’t afford my insulin. At that time, I didn’t have enough money to
take care of my girls, make sure they had food to eat, afford my
medication, and make it to the next pay day. I don’t want anyone to ever
have to feel that pain.

9. Our campaign is different. As Kentuckians, we all know what it’s like
to be ignored by politicians. That’s why we’re doing outreach in all 120
counties in Kentucky, from the hood to the holler, and having
conversations with folks from all walks of life. And that’s why we don’t
accept a single cent in donations from special interests, corporate PACs,
or Big Pharma.

10. Finally, I’m running for Senate because the people of Kentucky are my
family. My Grandad taught me that if someone disrespects one of us, they
have disrespected all of us. I am running for Senate because I am sick and
tired of seeing the lives of Kentuckians traded away for profit. We’ve
been disrespected long enough.

I love the Commonwealth of Kentucky. It is hard as hell to run for office
against cynicism and the big money machine, but the people of Kentucky are
my family, and you fight for family.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220810.UwuSn3&refcode=em20220810-2345&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=2345%2E346206%2ExDGn0T ]Peter, my
name is Charles Booker, I am a lifelong Kentuckian, proud husband, father,
and the person who is going to retire Rand Paul this November. Please help
me win this race by chipping in today.

Thank you for being a part of this,
Peter.

Charles

At that time, I didn’t have enough money to take care of my girls, make sure they had food to eat, afford my medication, and make it to the next pay day. I don’t want anyone to ever have to feel that pain. 9. Our campaign is different. As Kentuckians, we all know what it’s like to be ignored by politicians. That’s why we’re doing outreach in all 120 counties in Kentucky, from the hood to the holler, and having conversations with folks from all walks of life. And that’s why we don’t accept a single cent in donations from special interests, corporate PACs, or Big Pharma. 10. Finally, I’m running for Senate because the people of Kentucky are my family. My Grandad taught me that if someone disrespects one of us, they have disrespected all of us. I am running for Senate because I am sick and tired of seeing the lives of Kentuckians traded away for profit. We’ve been disrespected long enough. I love the Commonwealth of Kentucky. It is hard as hell to run for office against cynicism and the big money machine, but the people of Kentucky are my family, and you fight for family. [ ]Peter, my name is Charles Booker, I am a lifelong Kentuckian, proud husband, father, and the person who is going to retire Rand Paul this November. Please help me win this race by chipping in today. Thank you for being a part of this, Peter. Charles Contribute to Charles Booker:

Peter,

It was Friday, August 21, 2015.

I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers.

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Peter – I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values.

Meanwhile, three-letter executive agencies treat the average American as a target rather than a citizen with inalienable rights. **That’s why we see the Biden administration adding 87,000 new IRS agents to their ranks.** _If elected officials aren't safe from this abuse of power, the average American doesn't stand a chance._ It's time for a change in Washington, but not the insignificant change that politicians like to celebrate. We **NEED** an **OVERHAUL** of our federal government to root out the corruption and bias and restore accountability to the American people. Peter, the change I intend to bring to Washington won't come easy–**it will be the most challenging fight I've ever fought but also the most important. ** [**Peter, your encouragement keeps me going, and your support keeps my campaign fueled. Will you do me the honor of energizing this fight with a small grassroots donation in the next hour?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=91453a805d074405839e2591d4cfa800&_e=3O5YnZQ-MNynWeMkA9m-8Cid8Ch3Wb3SlNZA3kH0j6Ga-DtUcoNPoE7OKy-1TmoEk4Lz3qOopTUxvRNhU0O8ytKrpi-IY8l0DAGnmVmBhZ4jsMOuEjQUuYmfnyAMkpxeZc09qGU42y8LqArKyg9QUa9sttPYOVM-oTZM79NQYP7Iy-cPFUvoXKVD-8X67QKu5F7dgC_Sb9r8xQNKAfck9cS_7y5WZTD7wy6yhIsq150moqLawDL7vJXoprB_w1FSc3cLrmog2H9Mkt5r7WzW3tRzPYarBI6va_j-3gx54ap0yaZMbi3cdXANHePqJOO6MEuuaX7hEwMjoGj8MnlmAsRTim6WJM33bkW_OVI7UAKjbmljhvIq_oAre99IreAV7KuxmhcIL8-n11gUBQ-AyjgcMofM1_Psm6kC9ez2uDGh97BZD-1ootYZgHlxbk5NVQVMjblH43J45jSALuowsS8Rl51FHdSxRroHp-sI2m9lQ0xKDMyQarpNAc2N7R1TfPFZRaNW5fIfpaIYDl1oEw%3D%3D)

Peter, a lot of people know of me, but they don't know how I got here or why they should put their faith in me to lead. After 8 years of service as a U.S. Army Apache pilot, I returned home to my community to run the company that my dad started - an automotive supply-chain company. I worked hard, created good-paying American jobs, met the love of my life — my wife Liz — and started a family.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=91453a805d074405839e2591d4cfa800&_e=3O5YnZQ-MNynWeMkA9m-8Cid8Ch3Wb3SlNZA3kH0j6Ga-DtUcoNPoE7OKy-1TmoEk4Lz3qOopTUxvRNhU0O8ytKrpi-IY8l0DAGnmVmBhZ4jsMOuEjQUuYmfnyAMkpxeZc09qGU42y8LqArKyg9QUa9sttPYOVM-oTZM79NQYP7Iy-cPFUvoXKVD-8X67QKu5F7dgC_Sb9r8xQNKAfck9cS_7y5WZTD7wy6yhIsq150moqLawDL7vJXoprB_w1FSc3cLrmog2H9Mkt5r7WzW3tRzPYarBI6va_j-3gx54ap0yaZMbi3cdXANHePqJOO6CYsDatdmKrY_XcaUP4Y5OFQ5bmMGf0A3vWrPRFKj4bQM2c_s68M3t0WKsiBEkjvmJX9ShJhBrJEfCaofCwZ1q3VTfdthRH_3Ah9DwqvM47UvNXcB5XW34RlLXViuBeoQ4uF9PNRWGFkMifnlY3w05ndn9_mhFjADZFG5MPXV9eMHIX5bLwCo7FffRQDUCsoK5X62E6dpgB_7BCBVupFuUQ%3D%3D)

But I couldn’t remain on the sidelines. Even though my military career was over, I felt like I had more to give. I wanted to continue to serve the country and my community in any way that I could. _I never envisioned myself as a politician. _ But after watching Washington fail to deliver on promises for decades, I decided that I had to take action. I couldn’t let hardworking Michigan families be held back while career politicians fought for their own careers instead of their communities. I want to grow our economies back home, not continue growing Washington's. It’s time to get our tax dollars out of the hands of Washington politicians and back in our communities where they can make the biggest impact. **I hope you choose to become an OFFICIAL supporter of my campaign by making an immediate donation now:[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-michigan/action-4846211-id/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=91453a805d074405839e2591d4cfa800&_e=3O5YnZQ-MNynWeMkA9m-8Cid8Ch3Wb3SlNZA3kH0j6Ga-DtUcoNPoE7OKy-1TmoEk4Lz3qOopTUxvRNhU0O8ytKrpi-IY8l0DAGnmVmBhZ4jsMOuEjQUuYmfnyAMkpxeZc09qGU42y8LqArKyg9QUa9sttPYOVM-oTZM79NQYP7Iy-cPFUvoXKVD-8X67QKu5F7dgC_Sb9r8xQNKAfck9cS_7y5WZTD7wy6yhIsq150moqLawDL7vJXoprB_w1FSc3cLrmog2H9Mkt5r7WzW3tRzPYarBI6va_j-3gx54ap0yaZMbi3cdXANHePqJOO6f-9kDIEyJAbojLVIu9Kw1eC58mV-4CoFam3zPmNPIvBQPoa5ZAFB61jt0NlM99YNgRbjGxHWPKQSgyF7pCdYTeBL9A25dL3ho88iVnn3WWH6DkUgjO6-b7mgnGXI0-xA9gxD5Ds9PlzjrKlqAaCWDBpJ_0YAx6k7izTHci8b6qqtIU-XotmkByrAAT5WNkKeDCLYELuo-9UNiVFzeBr7fw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time,** ** John James

We're living in a deeply troubling time for our country. Washington being accountable to Americans is essentially a foreign concept at this point. Meanwhile, three-letter executive agencies treat the average American as a target rather than a citizen with inalienable rights. That’s why we see the Biden administration adding 87,000 new IRS agents to their ranks. If elected officials aren't safe from this abuse of power, the average American doesn't stand a chance. It's time for a change in Washington, but not the insignificant change that politicians like to celebrate. We NEED an OVERHAUL of our federal government to root out the corruption and bias and restore accountability to the American people. Peter, the change I intend to bring to Washington won't come easy–it will be the most challenging fight I've ever fought but also the most important. Peter, a lot of people know of me, but they don't know how I got here or why they should put their faith in me to lead. After 8 years of service as a U.S. Army Apache pilot, I returned home to my community to run the company that my dad started - an automotive supply-chain company. I worked hard, created good-paying American jobs, met the love of my life — my wife Liz — and started a family. But I couldn’t remain on the sidelines. Even though my military career was over, I felt like I had more to give. I wanted to continue to serve the country and my community in any way that I could. I never envisioned myself as a politician. But after watching Washington fail to deliver on promises for decades, I decided that I had to take action. I couldn’t let hardworking Michigan families be held back while career politicians fought for their own careers instead of their communities. I want to grow our economies back home, not continue growing Washington's. It’s time to get our tax dollars out of the hands of Washington politicians and back in our communities where they can make the biggest impact. name: Don Samuels
subject: Thank you, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Neighbors for Samuels
body:
---
| | Peter,

I wanted to reach out one last time and sincerely thank you for the support you’ve shown my campaign since day one. Without your support, we would not have been able to put up the fight that we did. It was an incredibly close race, and that is a testament to the work we have done together. While I expected different results, I would like to congratulate Rep. Omar on her victory. The voters of the Fifth District have signaled their approval of your years in Congress and have made it clear that they want more of your leadership in Washington. There is no denying that our community faces challenges. We must resolve ourselves to the hard work of reducing gun violence and freeing our communities from the vice of rising crime, find the things on which we agree and then build on them, and listen to one another and find compromises amongst our disagreements. I campaigned on a promise of making a difference and working with others. It is now my time to make true on my word and work with Rep. Omar to solve the problems facing our communities. I welcome her help at the federal level as I continue my work here in MN-05. Our next mission is to ensure a blue Fifth District. Now that the Primary has finished, it is time to come together and support our nominee so that we can continue to build on President Biden’s progressive agenda and protect the progress we’ve worked so hard to achieve. Thank you again, Peter. I am so proud of all that we have accomplished together throughout this campaign, and I look forward to seeing what the future holds. — Don Samuels

# To Bring Unity to CD7
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
Traveling around Colorado, I have met incredible people on both sides of the aisle.

All the voters with whom I have spoken love America and want to see our country flourish.

These are the people I will proudly represent in Washington.

It is no secret that I am a Republican. I am unashamed of my conservative roots. But I understand that my job is to represent everyone in our community, regardless of whether they view things differently than I do. I will not be swayed by political correctness or party lines, but rather I will make decisions that benefit the entire CD7 community.
Likewise, I will not shy away from discussions with colleagues on the "other side" or refuse to work with them simply because of the letter after their name. As a servant leader, I believe in the words of President John F. Kennedy: "Let us not seek the Republican answer or the Democratic answer but the right answer."

My desire is to bring unity to CD7 and to Congress as a whole. I will find common cause with anyone who wishes America to remain free and prosperous. While I will never be silent when it comes to declaring my stances on the issues, I will also always be a listening ear for my constituents. I will do my best to unify us under our shared belief that America is, and always will be, the greatest country the world has ever seen.

clean_body: Peter, last night was just the beginning. | | | Peter, last night was just the beginning. WFP champion Mandela Barnes declared victory in Wisconsin’s Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate. This is a huge step forward for our people-powered movement, but now we have to move on to the next step: Bringing together our grassroots supporters from all across the country to help Mandela unseat Republican Ron Johnson. Johnson has deep-pocketed donors and outside groups spending heaps of cash to defend him. We may not be able to match him dollar for dollar, but our movement has proven that we can be vastly outspent — and still win. Peter, your personal endorsement is really valuable and we want to be sure you have all the facts before you make a decision. So, here’s what you need to know about Mandela: He’s the proud son of union workers. In 2018, he was elected as Wisconsin’s first Black Lieutenant Governor. He has plans to fight climate change, support federal legislation that will create good jobs, and expand access to high-quality, affordable childcare. The latest polls show him leading Johnson by 2 points. And here’s what you need to know about Ron Johnson: He was deeply involved in Trump’s plans to overturn the 2020 election. He voted against the bipartisan gun violence bill. He has threatened to make cuts to Social Security and Medicare. He’s one of the most vulnerable Senators up for reelection. Republicans know that Mandela has a real shot at defeating Johnson, expanding our Senate majority, and championing our progressive agenda. They’re funneling money into this race to stop us, so we have to fight back the best way we know how: with people-power. Together, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. | | I’m Bee Nguyen, the Democratic nominee for Georgia’s Secretary of State.

**The Georgia GOP has used the Secretary of State’s office as a base for voter suppression for years!**

I know you’ve probably heard about Republican voter suppression efforts in Georgia. You’ve probably heard about how the Georgia GOP passed a voter suppression bill that makes it a crime to pass out water to voters standing in lines among other restrictions. And you’ve no doubt heard about Republican gerrymandering. And how they’ve restricted the number of secure drop boxes, making it harder for voters to safely and efficiently cast their ballots.

**And all of these efforts have been just in the past year and a half!**

Most recently, a Trump-appointed judge ruled that the at-large voting method for our state’s Public Service Commission violates Section 2 of the Federal Voting Rights Act and dilutes the power of Black voters. **Instead of celebrating this decision and working to make a more fair and open election, Brad Raffensperger, the Republican Secretary of State, appealed the decision, hoping to continue to disenfranchise Black voters.**

Raffensperger has been doing everything he can to make it more difficult for voters to cast a ballot. He has no interest in helping voters gain access to the ballot box. He has no interest in expanding the electorate.

[**_That’s why I’m asking you to split a donation right now between my campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia. ---
**TINA PETERS CHALLENGES RESULTS AND METHOD OF ILLEGALLY CONDUCTED RECOUNT - DEMANDS HAND RECOUNT** **GRAND JUNCTION, CO** \-- We ardently oppose the illegal manner in which this recount was conducted. Earlier this week, the Peters campaign released 5 separate verified assertions of improper conduct by the Secretary of State during this recount process.
Last week the Peters campaign filed a lawsuit against Secretary of State Jena Griswold in district court to stop this rushed and illegally conducted recount. Despite being completely paid for, with over $250,000 by supporters of Secretary of State Candidate Tina Peters – the recount was not conducted in a manner consistent with state law, or a true attempt to verify the results. They were conducted with “test ballots” under the directive of Dominion Voting Systems and the Secretary of State. Despite massive inconsistencies between Dominion voting machine tabulated results and verified data results, the Secretary of State has thus far refused to authorize a hand count–as state law both authorizes and requires her to do. The central point of the Peters’ campaign lawsuit is very simple, Colorado law (C.R.S. § 1-10.5-102 (3)(b)) states that if there are discrepancies between a machine and a hand count, that cannot be explained by voter error, then “voter verified paper records” should be used to make a final determination. Except, the hand count must be of the ballots that were cast in the race, not test ballots that in this case were used. After the hand count of all of the ballots that a randomly selected device tabulated on election day, the canvass board is then supposed to compare the two, before deciding on what method to use in the recount. They didn’t do that. The supporters of Secretary of State Candidate Tina Peters campaign simply request that, in accordance with Colorado law, the recount be completed lawfully and the hand count prescribed under the statute for a recount be conducted to ensure the accuracy of the voting machines. Transparency and integrity in our primary elections is fundamental. If there is nothing to hide, Jena Griswold, who herself touts Colorado as the “Gold Standard,” should want a true and transparent process as well. We say: “Just follow the law”.
---
